name: ECE 4211
title: Semiconductor Devices and Nanostructures
description: Principles and applications of contemporary solid state devices such as light-emitting diodes, injection lasers, solar cells, p-n-p-n diodes, SCRs and Triacs, transistors, MESFETs and MODFETs, and fundamentals of integrated circuits. Impact of nanostructures on devices.
requirement_description: ECE 3201; open only to students in the School of Engineering.
